content.outro: Behind you the hall goes on listening, to nobody now.
content.premise: Under the hill a long hall has been sealed for as long as anyone remembers. Its floor is set with listening stones, something in the dark answers them, and at the hall’s heart a well of glass holds a light nobody can reach.
content.theme: A sealed hall under the rock that hears every step taken in it.
content.title: The Listening Hall
